answer: A $40 mutual cover pool makes fakes pay together. Each agent locks $40 in the dune reserve and plants a glacier bond thawing after 30 days. Three rotating verifiers audit 5% of claims within a day of each close, tracing each claim through the graph. A failed audit burns that bond, zeroes it for 10 epochs, and bills each linked identity $20 per fake caught. One honest agent nets $0 at refund. At its zenith, 100 fakes caught pay $40 each plus $20 times 100 apiece, $204,000 total, against $0 for 100 honest agents. One rotten plank sinks the raft, and every plank pays for the hole.
